description: A lightweight, customizable toast-style notification library for Compose Multiplatform (Android, iOS, desktop, web): timed, persistent and clickable koasts, a FIFO queue, stacked cards, keyed in-place updates and swipe-to-dismiss.
rules: Create one KoastManager per screen or app, remember it, and wrap content in KoastyProvider
Call show* methods from event handlers, not during composition
Use the key parameter to update an existing koast in place instead of queueing a new one
Configure position, colors, gestures and display mode through KoastyHostConfig
